purpose: Fixed source interfaces for the FX505GT build-only cohort; native link/runtime qualification remains pending

Lilu.role: Header source only; no Lilu runtime binary is built or bundled

VirtualSMC.role: VirtualSMCSDK header source only; no VirtualSMC runtime binary is built or bundled

MacKernelSDK.role: Public kernel headers and tracked x86_64 libkmod.a build input

sdk_selection: Lilu and VirtualSMC pins are contemporary to the pinned AsusSMC source; all four actual target TUs compile against these interfaces and the reused public header closure. This is not final Apple SDK linkage or runtime compatibility evidence.
apple_tools: Native Xcode/macOS SDK and compiler must already exist on the build host. Their exact versions and SDKSettings hash are recorded, not assumed or installed. No Apple SDK is redistributed.

acpi.note: Build compiles the SSDT only; deployment also requires the separately guarded exact-fixture binary rename. Full DSDT DSL recompilation is not the delivery path.
